question: A journey is 46 km each way and my car uses 12 km per litre. Help me estimate fuel, then see what changes at different fuel prices.
answer:
At the original figures — 92 km round trip at 12 km/L — you need about 7.67 litres. Assuming $1.50 per litre (my placeholder, not a quoted price), that's roughly $11.50; the controls below let you change the fuel price and the trip details.

Fuel price is an editable assumption, not a quoted price."), Form([Input($oneWay, "Distance each way (km)", "number"), Input($economy, "Fuel economy (km per litre)", "number"), SegmentedControl($trip, ["One-way", "Round trip"]), Slider($price, 0.5, 4, 0.05, "Fuel price", "$/L")]), Card([Text([Icon("fuel", "sm"), "  Fuel needed: ", Badge(@Format($litres, "number", 2) + " L", "info")]), Title(@Format($cost, "currency", 2, "USD"), "2xl"), Caption(@Format($km, "number", 1) + " km driven at " + @Format(@Clamp(@Default($economy, 12), 0.1, 100), "number", 1) + " km/L")], "soft")])
$km = $trip == "Round trip" ? @Clamp(@Default($oneWay, 0), 0, 100000) * 2 : @Clamp(@Default($oneWay, 0), 0, 100000)
$litres = $km / @Clamp(@Default($economy, 12), 0.1, 100)
$cost = $litres * @Clamp(@Default($price, 0), 0, 100)
